baslik: Why Rockets Explode on the Launch Pad
aciklama:
A rocket is a controlled explosion pointed at the sky - and the line between launch and disaster is razor thin. Here is why they blow up.

#shorts #space #engineering #science #rockets

sahneler.metin: A rocket is basically a controlled explosion aimed at space.
Inside are hundreds of tons of fuel and oxidizer.
They must burn together in perfect, precise balance.
A tiny crack or a stuck valve breaks that balance.
The fuel ignites all at once instead of in a controlled burn.
The thin metal tanks cannot contain that much energy.
If it drifts off course, controllers destroy it on purpose.
Better a fireball over the ocean than over a city.
Every explosion teaches engineers how to fly the next one.
